no_week_runs_yet_description: A run record is written when a week is built. Build one and it will show up here.
run_record_rejected_hint: It does not match the run record schema, so the week is not shown at all — a partly-read record would hide whichever part failed.
unmatched_posts: scheduled posts missing from this record
schedule_unreadable: the schedule could not be read
stray_posts: posts in the record that the schedule no longer has
posts_all_matched: posts, all matched to the schedule
partially_authored: partially authored — Ace left no account
week_run_incomplete_warning: This is NOT a complete picture of the week. The record and the schedule disagree, so anything below is only the part they have in common — do not approve the week from this page until it is rebuilt.
checked_in_code_hint: Re-derived from the files and the database when this page loaded. None of it is the agent’s account of itself.
copy_edited_detail: The captions on this page are the ones the run recorded. What is on disk now differs, and what was pushed may differ from both.
not_linked_to_postiz: of them carry no Postiz id, so their live state cannot be checked from here. Weeks pushed before 12 Aug 2026 never recorded one.
approval_gate_on: This organization requires approval, so a post stays a draft until an approver releases it.
approval_gate_off: This organization does not require approval, so nothing here was gated.
handoffs_hint: Computed from the week’s copy and platform routing, not declared by the agent.
no_handoffs: Nothing in this week needs a human step.
not_in_this_record: Scheduled, but not in this record
ace_own_account: Ace’s own account of this run
ace_own_account_hint: Written by Ace at the end of the run. Nothing below is checked by anything — it is the agent describing itself, and it is shown separately for that reason.
account_rejected: Ace left an account, but it was rejected:
no_account_written: Ace did not write an account of this run. The record above still stands — it is built from the files either way — but there is no stated reasoning to read.
nothing_listed_unverified: Ace listed nothing as unverified. That is a claim, not a result.
not_in_postiz: no such post in this organization
account_is_stale_detail: This account was written before the record above was built, so it is about an earlier version of this week. Read it as history, not as an explanation of what is scheduled now.
next_free_slot_unavailable: Could not find the next free slot, keeping the current time
draft_saved_without_a_date: Saved without a date. Find it under Undated drafts.
